records.article_diplomatic: Geneſen. Sauguiba, oder wie ſie zu ſagen pflegen: rachpé ne ganíle, ich bin etwas geſund.
records.uncertainty_note: The Rarámuri phrase is retained provisionally from the facsimile.

records.article_diplomatic: Geſchmack. Igué gá, das heißt: ſehr gut.
Geſchwind. Hiá, hiága: vielfach hiáſi. Belágo. Geſchwind, das Beywort. Gualíneke.
records.uncertainty_note: Compact Rarámuri forms and accents remain pending independent linguistic collation.
The long Rarámuri form is a provisional direct facsimile reading.

records.article_diplomatic: Geſund. Ganelíameke, d. i. dem es wohlgehet. Wenn ich aber frage: wie befindeſt du dich? auchi mu inile, ſo antwortet er: ganémile: ich bin geſund, oder wohlauf.
records.uncertainty_note: Article continues from printed p. 320 into the top of p. 321. The Rarámuri question and answer forms remain pending linguistic verification.

records.article_diplomatic: Getauft. Pagorúgameke. Sie pflegen auch zu ſagen: Ipagatúgameke.
records.uncertainty_note: Both Rarámuri forms are visually compact and remain provisional pending linguistic collation.

records.article_diplomatic: Getreidemaaß. Tſchivávoli. Eine Metze, welche die dortigen Spanier Fanega, oder oder auch Aneya nennen.
records.uncertainty_note: The historical measure name and Rarámuri form are retained from the facsimile; the source visibly repeats `oder`.
The Rarámuri form is visually read as `Mallisi`; the supplied OCR is strongly corrupted and independent linguistic collation is needed.

records.article_diplomatic: Gleichwie. Mapú recá, imapú réuega. Hatſchí réuega, hatſchí recá.
records.uncertainty_note: The second comparative form is visually difficult; `imapú réuega` is a provisional reading supported by the supplied OCR.
